summary: Require every supplied condition to hold.
documentation: all returns False at the first falsey item, otherwise True. With no items it returns True. Use a generator to test each item without building a separate list.
inputs: An iterable containing values or condition results.
returns: A Boolean indicating whether every item is truthy.
caution: Empty input passes all by definition. Add a separate nonempty check when a business rule requires at least one item.
scenarios: Confirm all mandatory fields passed validation.
Check that every shipment item has sufficient stock.
Require all reviewers to approve a change.
title: Check a nonempty shipping batch
problem: Input is a list of package weights. Return True only when the list is nonempty and every weight is greater than 0. Return False for an empty list, zero or a negative weight.
goal: Use all() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Combine a nonempty check with all over the positivity condition.
